subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw change core sub-agent bootstrap or MiniMax image routing specifically for MiniMax Token Plan users, or keep the current narrow bootstrap boundary and fix only live-proven provider/media bugs?
rationale: The code paths are intentional and documented, while the report's Token Plan-specific endpoint and office-skill expectations need maintainer product direction before automation can safely change compatibility-sensitive provider and bootstrap behavior.

options.title: Keep boundary, prove provider bug first
options.body: Preserve AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent bootstrap, request live Token Plan endpoint proof, and fix only confirmed MiniMax image/media behavior while routing office skills through plugin, skill, CLI, or ClawHub surfaces.

options.title: Add explicit Token Plan sub-agent support
options.body: Approve a new opt-in bootstrap or bundle contract for Token Plan skills, with docs and regression coverage for inherited skill availability and credential handling.

options.title: Close as external support after proof window
options.body: If no redacted live Token Plan proof arrives, treat the remaining mmx CLI and office-bundle behavior as external setup rather than OpenClaw core work.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary, prove provider bug first
recommendation.body: Preserve AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent bootstrap, request live Token Plan endpoint proof, and fix only confirmed MiniMax image/media behavior while routing office skills through plugin, skill, CLI, or ClawHub surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans sub-agent runtime policy, bootstrap compatibility, and provider behavior where recent history shows broad adjacent ownership.
